answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to lock a refundable bond, then slash it when independently verified evidence shows coordinated reward fraud. Raise withdrawal limits only after the agent completes tasks for several unrelated counterparties, whose signed attestations form a ripple of trust rather than relying on one sponsor. A sybil farmer must tie up capital in every account and pay for diverse, sustained activity; an opal or oasis profile name alone earns no reputation.
